apps.name: Fitness Test Pro Elite
apps.tagline: Score any military fitness test in seconds.
apps.summary: Fitness test calculator for every branch.
intro: Fitness Test Pro Elite is a fitness test calculator for the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard and special operations screening tests. Pick your branch, enter your events and see your total and pass/fail using the published scoring tables.

lists.title: Branches and tests
items: Army: Army Fitness Test (AFT), alternate aerobic events, Combat or General standard by MOS, Combat Field Test timer, waist-to-height check
Navy: Physical Readiness Test with altitude adjustments, Navy Combat Fitness Test, body composition
Air Force: PFRA with the 2026 scoring charts, waist-to-height component, special warfare standards
Marine Corps: PFT and CFT, class thresholds, body composition
Coast Guard: PFT with run, row or swim, body composition
Special operations: selection-course entry tests such as the SEAL and SWCC PST, Air Force special warfare, MARSOC, Ranger and Special Forces screeners

lists.title: iPhone Duo
text: On the open inner display, the menu sits on the left page and the calculator on the right, with your live score next to your inputs.
Free to score a test in every branch. Ads appear on result screens.
The Full Version is a one-time purchase per branch, or All Branches unlocks every branch, including branches added later. Any purchase removes ads. No subscription.
Full Version adds saved results and history, event-by-event breakdowns, target and goal planners, and branch extras like combat fitness tests, body composition, scoring tables and guided timers.

faq.a: No. Fitness Test Pro Elite is an independent, unofficial calculator. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the U.S. Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, Department of Defense, Department of Homeland Security or any government agency. Official results come from your command's fitness program and current policy.

faq.q: How do I restore a purchase?
faq.a: Tap Restore Purchases in the paywall or in About, signed in with the same Apple Account.
Buy any branch or All Branches.
On your device only. No login, no account, no cloud sync.

p: None directly. There is no account, login or server run by us. The scores, measurements and results you enter stay on your device. We cannot see them.

The free version shows ads on result screens (a banner and occasional full-screen ads). Ads are served by Google AdMob. Where the law requires it, Google's consent form is shown before any ad is requested, and you can change your choice later under Ad Privacy Choices in the app.
On first launch the app asks permission through Apple's App Tracking Transparency. If you decline, you still get every feature and AdMob shows non-personalized ads.

AdMob may collect your device's advertising identifier (only if you allow tracking), device information, approximate location from your IP address, ad interactions and diagnostics, under [Google's Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). We don't receive or store this data. Any purchase removes ads.

Optional one-time purchases unlock the Full Version for a branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, SOF screening) or All Branches. There is no subscription. Apple processes all payments through the App Store; we never see your payment details. Apple confirms your purchases on your device so they can unlock and restore.
Not used. Your results are not synced anywhere.

No name, email, contacts or analytics run by us.
Delete saved results in the app. Deleting the app removes all of its data from your device.
Not directed to children under 13. We don't knowingly collect personal information from children.

apps.name: Unhabit
apps.tagline: Quit habits and track recovery, without the all-or-nothing reset.
intro: Most habit trackers treat one slip like a full reset. Unhabit helps you recover quickly, understand your triggers and keep moving forward. Log cravings in seconds, record slips without losing your journey, and watch your Recovery Score grow.

lists.title: Highlights
items: Log cravings and slips in seconds
Recovery Score instead of fragile streaks
Milestones, patterns and triggers
Export your recovery report
Private and local-first: your logs stay on your iPhone

text: Unhabit is free and tracks two unhabits at once. Unhabit Pro is a one-time purchase with no subscription and no ads. Pro adds:
items: Track every unhabit at once
Streak history and advanced analytics
All recovery insights and full weekly reviews
The full milestone path
Home and Lock Screen widgets
Extra looks with matching app icons
after: Earlier Unhabit Premium purchases (yearly or Lifetime) keep everything.

faq.a: Tap Restore Purchases in Settings, signed in with the same Apple Account.

faq.q: I had Premium. Do I need Pro?
faq.a: No. Earlier Premium purchases unlock everything Pro does.

faq.q: How do I cancel an old Premium yearly subscription?
faq.a: Open Settings on your iPhone, tap your name, then Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before it renews.
Yes. Your logs are stored on your device and never sent to us.

sections.h: Your data stays on your device
p: Unhabit has no accounts and no server run by us. Your unhabits, cravings, slips, check-ins and notes are stored on your iPhone. We cannot see them and they are never sent to us.

Unhabit has no ads and no third-party advertising or analytics SDKs, and does not track you across apps or websites. We don't collect your name, email, location, contacts, advertising identifiers or usage analytics.

Unhabit Pro is a one-time in-app purchase. Earlier Unhabit Premium purchases (yearly subscription or Lifetime) are still honored. Apple processes all payments through the App Store; we never receive your payment details. Apple confirms what you own on your device so Pro can unlock and restore. Apple's handling is covered by the [Apple Privacy Policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/).
Not used. Your logs are not synced to any cloud service.
Home and Lock Screen widgets read your progress from a shared container on the same device. Nothing leaves your iPhone.

Notifications, only if you turn on reminders. Reminders are scheduled on your device and no notification content leaves your iPhone. Unhabit does not access location, contacts, camera, microphone, photos or Apple Health.
If you export your recovery report, it goes only where you choose to send it from the share sheet.
Erase everything in Settings > Erase All Data. Deleting the app removes its data from your device.
Unhabit is not directed to children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect personal information from anyone.

apps.tagline: Build it. Fly it. Stick the landing.

Stick it: touch down on a rolling ship, the Moon or Mars

apps.tagline: Carry it, stack it, build the drones.
